en.title: Immersive 3-Screen Content and MR/VR Experience Day [Oct 08 (Thu) 10:30–11:30 AM / 3:00–4:00 PM]
summary: The Remote Education Support Center is hosting an Immersive 3-Screen Content and MR/VR Experience Day.
The event will take place on Thursday, October 8, 2026, across two sessions (10:30–11:30 AM and 15:00–16:00 PM) at Metaspace on the 1st floor of Jungseok Memorial Library.
Each session operates on a reservation system for up to 4 participants via the provided application links.
The event will only run if there are at least 2 applicants, and participants who submit the post-event satisfaction survey will receive 1 extracurricular mileage point (1 point per semester).
en.easyExplanation: Inha University members can join an immersive 3-screen and MR/VR experience at Metaspace on the 1st floor of Jungseok Memorial Library. It runs on Thursday, October 8 with morning and afternoon sessions (up to 4 people per session), and submitting a satisfaction survey afterwards earns you 1 extracurricular mileage point.
en.target: Inha University members (in the case of international members, must be able to communicate in Korean)

originalContent:
안녕하세요 원격교육지원센터입니다.
실감 3면 콘텐츠 및 MR/VR 체험Day를 실시하오니
여러분의 많은 관심과 참여 바랍니다.
1. 대상 : 인하대학교 구성원 (외국인인 경우 한국어 의사소통 가능자)
2. 장소 : 정석학술정보관 1층 메타스페이스
3. 일시 ① 2026.10.8.(목) 오전 10:30~11:30 (4명 예약제)
[신청주소 : https://mooc.inha.ac.kr/ko/e_learning/workshop/view/10401?p=1&status=all ]
② 2026.10.8.(목) 오후 15:00~16:00 (4명 예약제)
[신청주소 :https://mooc.inha.ac.kr/ko/e_learning/workshop/view/10402?p=1&status=all]
4. 체험목록
5. 소개영상(1분) : https://openlearn.inha.ac.kr/local/ubonline/open_view.php?id=118
6. 주요안내사항
- 행사 당일 오전에 안내 문자를 보내드립니다.
- 신청자 2명 이상인 경우에만 행사가 진행 되오니 참고 부탁드립니다.
- 참여 후 만족도 조사 설문 제출시 비교과 마일리지 1점을 부여해 드립니다.(학기당 1점)
감사합니다.
